To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the tyrosine protein kinase activity of the pp60c-Src protein from neuroblastoma Neuro-2A cells is 10 times higher than that found in fibroblastic cell types.

the Vmax. for pp60c- src from the C130O neuroblastoma cell lines is 7-15 fold greater than that of pp60c- Src from fibroblastic cells, and that the ATP Km value for the enzyme from neuroblastoma cell is similar to that of pp60v-src from fibroblast and Rous-sarcomavirus-transformed fibroblast.
The pp60c-src protein tyrosine kinase of neuroblastoma cells is more active than the enzyme of normal fibroblasts.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanism of activation of the pp60c-Src kinase in neuroblastoma and Rous sarcoma virus-transformed cells.
the mechanism of action of the protein tyrosine kinase, pp60c-Src, which is a key regulatory protein in cell transformation.
the role that the tyrosine kinase pp60c-src plays in neural development and function, and the mechanisms of pp60c-scr activation in the nervous system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the neuroblastoma pp60c-src enzyme has a higher turnover than pp60c- src in fibroblastic cells.

the increased activity of pp60c-Src in neuroblastoma cell lines is a consequence of a higher turnover number (Vmax./Km) of the enzyme in these cells, rather than a consequence of an altered Km for the substrate angiotensin.

the increased specific activity exhibited by pp60c-src isolated from neuroblastoma cell lines, compared to pp60c-src purified from normal fibroblasts or pp60v-src purified from Rous sarcoma virus-transformed cells, is due to an increased Vmax. value for the tyrosine kinase reaction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
pp60c-src is activated in neuroblastoma by a posttranslational mechanism.
the neuroblastoma pp60c-src is more catalytically active than the fibroblast pp60c-src and the pp60v-src from RSV-transformed cells.
pp60c-src is more active in neural cells, but not because of any change in the catalytic efficiency of the enzyme.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the neuroblastoma form of the enzyme is not a hyperactive variant of pp60c- src but rather a variant that is more active than the enzyme expressed in fibroblast.
the Vmax. for pp60c-Src from neuro-2A cells is about 15 times greater than the VMax. for pp60v-Src.
the Vmax. is the same in the two cell types, and the difference is in the Km for the substrate.
